question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

She's under the __allusion __that she'll get the job.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"allusion"** means an indirect or passing reference. (संकेत)

 
 
• **Example: **His speech made an **allusion** to the recent economic crisis.
 
 
 
• **"Illusion"** refers to a false idea or belief, something that deceives by producing a false or misleading impression of reality. (भ्रम)
 
 
• **Example: **She had the** illusion** that she could win the lottery without buying a ticket.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is:*** illusion**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Vision **(दृष्टि): The ability to think about or plan the future with imagination or wisdom.

 
 
• **Example:** His** vision** for the company's future is very promising.
 
 
 
• **Hallucination **(भ्रम): An experience involving the apparent perception of something not present.
 
 
• **Example: **He suffered from** hallucinations** due to high fever.
 
 
 
• **Unreality** (अवास्तविकता): The quality of being imaginary or not real.
 
 
• **Example:** The story was filled with a sense of **unreality.**
